scripts.dev: node scripts/run-with-env.js development -- concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --mode development"
scripts.build:dev: node scripts/run-with-env.js development -- npm --prefix backend run build && node scripts/run-with-env.js development -- npm --prefix frontend run build -- --mode development
scripts.build:prod: node scripts/run-with-env.js production -- npm --prefix backend run build && node scripts/run-with-env.js production -- npm --prefix frontend run build -- --mode production
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node scripts/run-with-env.js development -- npm --prefix backend run db:migrate
scripts.db:deploy:prod: node scripts/run-with-env.js production -- npm --prefix backend exec prisma migrate deploy
